# First-source context

This is an informed original-AST checking study. The author previously read the
current shared Formals/pattern paths, both original-AST candidate/dataflow notes,
the authoritative type/source References, selected owner and predicate tests,
and all four actual stdlib registry files. These are not blind model attempts.
The deployed model identifier and sampling settings were unavailable; no external
model was invoked. The eighteen sources are newly authored existing-grammar
controls, not copied corpus/stdlib bodies or repairs of earlier observations.

Root previously reported QFT fixture commit
a4a5dfbcca34fa5e600a5f33703c360f13221ecb. That historical reference is not a fresh
Git query or an attestation of the current uncommitted Formals implementation.
Root's final Formals/source/CLI barrier is required before any capture is frozen
or run. This packet records first source bytes only; no CLI/native/collector,
Rust/Lean build or test was run during authoring.

An empty main does not authorize unchecked private or unused declarations.
Dead branches and zero folds retain owner/type/access/effect obligations. Current
finite eligibility and selected projection failures may mask the desired generic
judgment; those early failures are not evidence for a downstream property.
The runtime-shadows-static-policy case deliberately leaves the documented
finite/sized policy divergence unresolved. Complete std source checking includes
Basis, Meaning, qif/computed/operator/instrument rules; this packet does not claim
to cover all of them or adopt a canonical loader/namespace policy.

Only future bounded check observations are proposed. No run/sample/emission,
numerical oracle, source-preservation proof, general Fourier proof, guarantee,
canonical std/QFT exposure, Issue completion or maximum/stress case is included.
Existing QS/PR/RS/EXACT obligations and the two restricted ordinary QLV1 guarantees
remain unchanged. No AI interpretation or guarantee is adopted.
